comment: The statement that the architecture does not “redefine or duplicate” foundational DPI is sound, but the document later permits health to establish interim identity, consent, trust, and exchange capabilities. Without transition rules, temporary health-sector capabilities may become permanent parallel infrastructure.

anchor.note: p.26 l.Lines 86-91 read as the printed page; section 2.1.3 agrees

public.text: The statement that the architecture does not “redefine or duplicate” foundational DPI is sound, but the document later permits health to establish interim identity, consent, trust, and exchange capabilities. Without transition rules, temporary health-sector capabilities may become permanent parallel infrastructure.
public.suggestedRevision: Require every interim health-sector substitute for absent foundational DPI to include a documented transition, interoperability, and decommissioning or convergence plan.
